svg.aria-label: lystriq: i build clean tools, games and apps that work and that people use. now: work sixmonths · ai startup · station f. school esgi · 3-year work-study. 42 paris · common core. 8h-18h schools & work · 18h-21h my own projects. projects: claude-accounts (live): run several claude code accounts side by side, each in its own terminal, with one shared setup. no logout, no login. drone (step 0): a 25 g quad running my own flight firmware. no preflashed flight controller, 3d printed frame, zero soldering, 250 € budget. how i work: claude code writes most of my code. i do the architecture, the big decisions, the ui and the users. the drone is the exception: i write its c firmware myself.
lystriq: i build clean tools, games and apps that work and that people use.
